---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")
#let level-plus = rgb("#FFF4BF")
#let level-4 = rgb("#D5D9DC")
#let level-3 = rgb("#E2E5E7")
#let level-2 = rgb("#ECEEEF")
#let level-1 = rgb("#F5F6F7")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.32in, bottom: 0.50in, x: 0.52in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: "Source Sans 3",
      size: 6.8pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - you may share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: "Source Sans 3",
  size: 10.3pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.54em, justify: false)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 2.65in),
  column-gutter: 24pt,
  align: top,
  [
    #text(size: 26pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[0.0 Name Tag PDF]
    #v(1pt)
    #text(size: 11.5pt, fill: slate)[Clear photo. Clear file. Clear submission.]
  ],
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (0.58in, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 9pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.54in)],
      [
        #text(size: 8.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
        #linebreak()
        #text(size: 7.7pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
      ],
    )
  ],
)

#v(7pt)
#line(length: 0.62in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
#v(3pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.4pt + navy)
#v(7pt)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 18pt,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Value:] /10],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Submit:] Google Classroom],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Final file:] one PDF],
)
#v(5pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.7pt + mist)

#v(7pt)
#text(size: 15.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning goal]
#v(3pt)
I can take a clear, well-composed photo, create and check a PDF that includes my student number, and follow digital submission instructions carefully.

#v(6pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 4pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 12pt, right: 12pt, top: 6pt, bottom: 6pt),
)[
  #text(size: 10pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Why are we doing this?]
  #v(2pt)
  #text(size: 9pt)[This is practice for a course skill we will use again: turning clear work into one organized PDF, checking it, and submitting the correct file.]
]

#v(8pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1.34fr, 0.66fr),
  column-gutter: 24pt,
  align: top,
  [
    #text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Your mission]
    #v(4pt)
    #table(
      columns: (0.34in, 1fr),
      inset: (x: 6pt, y: 4.6pt),
      stroke: 0.5pt + mist,
      align: left + top,
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[1]], [Take a clear, well-lit photo of your name tag.],
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[2]], [Add the photo to a Google Doc or other software that can create a PDF.],
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[3]], [Crop and resize the photo so the name tag is clear and easy to read.],
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[4]], [Include your student number on the page using the exact format shown at right. Replace #text(style: "italic")[student-number] with your actual student number.],
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[5]], [Export or save the finished page as a #text(weight: "bold")[PDF].],
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[6]], [Open the PDF and check that everything is clear, upright, complete, and easy to read.],
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[7]], [Submit the PDF to Google Classroom.],
    )
  ],
  [
    #text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Required format]
    #v(4pt)
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      fill: navy,
      inset: (x: 12pt, y: 12pt),
    )[
      #text(size: 8.2pt, fill: white)[TYPE THIS ON THE PAGE]
      #v(4pt)
      #text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: white)[Submitted by: student-number]
    ]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: slate)[Replace #text(style: "italic")[student-number] with your actual student number.]

    #v(10pt)
    #text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Before you submit]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 9.2pt)[
      #box(width: 7pt, height: 7pt, stroke: 0.7pt + slate) #h(4pt) Name tag is easy to read #linebreak()
      #box(width: 7pt, height: 7pt, stroke: 0.7pt + slate) #h(4pt) Photo is cropped and oriented correctly #linebreak()
      #box(width: 7pt, height: 7pt, stroke: 0.7pt + slate) #h(4pt) Student number is included in the exact format #linebreak()
      #box(width: 7pt, height: 7pt, stroke: 0.7pt + slate) #h(4pt) File opens as a PDF #linebreak()
      #box(width: 7pt, height: 7pt, stroke: 0.7pt + slate) #h(4pt) I opened the final PDF and checked it
    ]
  ],
)

#pagebreak()

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, auto),
  align: horizon,
  [#text(size: 18pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[0.0 Name Tag PDF · Rubric · /10]],
  [#text(size: 7.7pt, fill: slate)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]],
)
#v(3pt)
#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: slate)[Each criterion is worth #text(weight: "bold")[2 marks], for a total of /10: 4+ = 2 marks · Level 4 = 1.5 marks · Level 3 = 1 mark · Level 2 = 0.5 marks · Level 1 = 0 marks.]
#v(6pt)

#table(
  columns: (1.12fr, 1.18fr, 1.24fr, 1.24fr, 1.18fr, 1.12fr),
  inset: (x: 5.5pt, y: 5.5pt),
  align: left + top,
  stroke: 0.5pt + white,
  fill: (x, y) => {
    if x == 1 { level-plus }
    else if x == 2 { level-4 }
    else if x == 3 { level-3 }
    else if x == 4 { level-2 }
    else if x == 5 { level-1 }
    else { white }
  },
  table.header(
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Criterion]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[4+ · 2 marks]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 4 · 1.5 marks]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 3 · 1 mark]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 2 · 0.5 marks]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 1 · 0 marks]],
  ),

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Photo quality] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Can we clearly read the name tag?]],
  [Exceptionally clear, well-lit, sharp, and easy to read.],
  [Clear, well-lit, and easy to read with only a minor imperfection.],
  [Readable and appropriately lit; some improvement is possible.],
  [Partly difficult to read because of lighting, blur, angle, or distance.],
  [Photo is missing or too unclear to use.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Crop & layout] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Is the page clean and focused?]],
  [Photo is carefully cropped, sized, oriented, and placed for excellent readability.],
  [Photo is well cropped, sized, oriented, and easy to view.],
  [Layout works, but there may be extra background, awkward sizing, or minor orientation issues.],
  [Layout makes the name tag unnecessarily small or difficult to view.],
  [Photo is not appropriately placed, cropped, or oriented.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Student number] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did you identify your submission correctly?]],
  [Correct student number is easy to find and uses the exact required format.],
  [Correct student number is included with only a very minor formatting issue.],
  [Student number is present but the required format is not followed.],
  [Identification is incomplete or difficult to find.],
  [Student number is missing or incorrect.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[PDF skill] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did you create and check the file?]],
  [Clean, correct PDF opens properly and has clearly been checked before submission.],
  [Correct PDF opens properly and is complete with only a minor issue.],
  [PDF is usable, but has a small file, page, or presentation issue.],
  [File is technically a PDF but has significant readability, page, or export problems.],
  [Submission is not a usable PDF.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Following instructions] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did you complete the whole process?]],
  [Every instruction is followed carefully and the final submission is complete.],
  [All required instructions are followed with only a minor oversight.],
  [Most instructions are followed; one required element needs correction.],
  [Several instructions are missed or repeated prompting is needed.],
  [Submission is incomplete or does not demonstrate the required process.],
)
```
